services.title: Intelligent AI Automation Services for Your Business
services.description: Business automation solutions with AI agents and N8N workflows to save time, eliminate errors, and deliver 24/7 professional service to your clients.

service1.title: Automatic Order Management
service1.description: Receive orders via WhatsApp, web or phone and have them registered automatically. Instant confirmation to the client, notification to you, everything organized without losing anything.
service1.ideal: 💡 Ideal for: Bakeries, pastry shops, restaurants

service2.title: 24/7 Virtual Assistant with AI Agents
service2.description: Intelligent AI agent with natural language processing that responds to clients automatically: schedules, prices, availability, location. Conversational automation that only escalates complex queries to human attention.
service2.ideal: 💡 Ideal for: Hair salons, workshops, clinics

service3.title: Smart Reminders & Notifications
service3.description: Send appointment reminders automatically 24h before. Notify when an order is ready. Manage cancellations without lifting a finger.

service4.title: Instant Automatic Invoicing
service4.description: Generate PDF invoices from any order or service. Sent automatically to the client and archived in Drive. Zero time wasted on paperwork.

service5.title: More Google Maps Reviews
service5.description: After every sale or service, an automatic message requests a review with a direct link. More visibility, more new clients.

service6.title: All Messages in One Place
service6.description: WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, email... all on one screen. Reply from one place and never miss an important client conversation.
